name: lauterbrunnen_context
title: Lauterbrunnen Valley, Bernese Oberland, Switzerland
note: A glacial trough: a flat floor about 800 m up between limestone walls 300-500 m sheer, the hanging terraces of Wengen and Muerren above them.
grid: local azimuthal equidistant (sphere R=6371008.8 m) centred on centre_lat/centre_lon; x east, y north; row 0 = north edge; pixel centre x = (col + 0.5 - cols/2) * pixel_size_m, y = (rows/2 - row - 0.5) * pixel_size_m

source.dataset: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen / Tilezen joerd), Terrarium PNG encoding, AWS Open Data elevation-tiles-prod
source.publisher: Mapzen / Linux Foundation Tilezen, hosted by AWS
source.native_resolution_m: varies by region: 3DEP 3-10 m (USA), EU-DEM 25 m (Europe), SRTM 30-90 m, GMTED, ETOPO1
